Disclaimers & methodology

How to read this table

All models use a 0.25° grid. RMSE rows treat Zeus as the reference; IFS and AIFS values marked * are higher error relative to that reference.

This table summarizes product characteristics and benchmark outcomes. It is not a promise of future performance, availability, or API latency.

RMSE & benchmarks

RMSE vs IFS uses published marketing figures. RMSE vs AIFS is derived from ERA5 benchmark aggregates on this site.

For full methodology, lead-time breakdowns, and statistical context, read the scientific report linked below or explore the interactive benchmarks above this section.

Availability & dissemination

Zeus availability after cycle init is approximately ~1.5 h. ECMWF open-data dissemination is approximately ~6 h and aligns with the public schedule (typically ~5 h 45 m–7 h 34 m after init for operational products).

Actual delivery times vary by run, product stream, and your access path.

ECMWF schedule (IFS & AIFS)

IFS run times, forecast horizons, and output steps follow ECMWF open-data documentation. AIFS offerings differ—confirm on ECMWF AIFS dataset pages (†).
